title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-21
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Excellent sound‑board capture of a high‑energy 1969 show, highlighted by Dark Star, Viola Lee and an unforgettable second‑set jam chain.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a classic, crystal‑clear sound‑board source that does justice to the raw, ragged power of this April ’69 Ark gig.  The band rolls from a loose first set into a spectacular second set featuring a Foxy Lady jam, Dark Star, St Stephen → The Eleven → Love Light and a soaring Viola Lee encore, with standout guitar work on Hard To Handle and Cryptical.  Minor blemishes – a sloppy opening, a hit‑or‑miss Foxy Lady and an unremarkable Alligator – don’t detract from the overall excitement.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (mostly 4‑5 stars) and strong praise for both performance and recording quality across >10 reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call it “well recorded” and note the classic 1969 sound‑board clarity; no dropout or balance complaints were mentioned.

standout_songs: "That's It for the Other One" (The Other One)
poor_songs: Hard To Handle (slide guitar deemed only ‘interesting’ or not great by one reviewer)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set starts a bit uneven but quickly gains momentum; the second set is a seamless jam chain – Foxy Lady jam → Dark Star → St. Stephen → The Eleven → Love Light – capped with a fiery Viola Lee encore and lingering Feedback.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Slide guitar on Hard To Handle praised by several reviewers; his quick‑fire Foxy Lady jam noted as a highlight; gorgeous guitar work on Cryptical.
